name: clock-inversion-is-per-utterance-and-progressive
why: VERIFIED P0-2, WITH A CORRECTION. The source audit attributed run 7acb0cc9's -13,973 ms to the run having processed only one of four utterances. That is FALSE — all four processed, each with source and target transcripts. The real defect is per-utterance and progressive: audio_queued − speech_end = +3424, +1231, -1435, -2364 ms. The LATER two are inverted. Nearest-rank p50 over those four is -1435 ms, which is exactly the '-1.44 s' rendered in Results › By Recording. A write-time guard is the BACKSTOP, not the fix — relabelling the run `failed` would hide a systematic drift in how speech_end is assigned per utterance.

must_include.reason: the report names WHICH utterances inverted; a run-level verdict alone loses the drift signal
